mapper.select: SELECT id, title, abstract AS abstractText, metadata, -- 计算向量得分 1 - (embedding <=> cast(#{vectorStr} as vector)) as score FROM papers WHERE -- 逻辑：语义得分 > 阈值 OR 标题包含关键词 (1 - (embedding <=> cast(#{vectorStr} as vector)) > #{threshold}) OR (title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
